svg.title: Roadmap. Next, in this order: An overlay for Arena. Sideboard guides, with no generated answers. Win rates per card, from your own games. Your matches as a CSV file, and every table column explained. Magic Online on the Live page. Later, in no set order: A page that shows the tracker is reading your log. Written guides with any model. macOS, Arena only. Historic, Explorer and Timeless. Dates are not promised.
